# Crypto-Backed Loans: Which Ones Get Liquidated?

A user borrows euros and locks bitcoin as collateral; if bitcoin falls far enough that the loan reaches 85% of the collateral's value, the collateral is sold. Which loans end up liquidated, and when?

**Notebook:** [loan_liquidations.ipynb](loan_liquidations.ipynb) · **Data:** [loans.csv](loans.csv), synthetic, generated by [make_data.py](make_data.py); the bitcoin prices are real, from [../bitcoin_forecast](../bitcoin_forecast)

## Data

508 bitcoin-backed loans issued from January 2024 to October 2025, with amount, starting loan-to-value (30%, 50%, or 70%), rate, term, and outcome. Liquidations happen on the dates the real bitcoin price fell.

## Approach

1. Compared liquidation rates by starting loan-to-value.
2. Calculated how far bitcoin has to fall to liquidate each kind of loan.
3. Charted liquidations against the bitcoin price.

## Results

- Of 508 loans, 61 were liquidated, all of them opened at 70% loan-to-value (37% of those); no loan at 30% or 50% was.
- A 70% loan survives only an 18% fall in bitcoin; at 50% it takes a 41% fall.
- Liquidations come in bursts on the days bitcoin fell sharply, most of all in November 2025.

## Tools

Python, pandas, NumPy, matplotlib
